MESSAGE:
Dear Acme Cloud Services team,

Thank you for your email regarding renewal of our services agreement, currently running from 1 November 2025 to 31 October 2026. We value our partnership and are open to renewing for a further 12 months under Clause 8.1.

However, the proposed 12% increase exceeds the price cap set out in Clause 8.2, which limits renewal increases to 7% unless both parties agree otherwise in writing. A 12% increase would bring the annual fee to Rs 26,88,000, up from the current Rs 24,00,000 (Rs 2,00,000/month). We are not in a position to accept an increase above 10%, and increases above 5% require our Finance Director's approval with written justification.

Separately, under Clause 4.1 (99.9% monthly uptime SLA) and Clause 4.2 (5% monthly fee service credit for shortfalls), your service missed target in May 2026 (99.42%) and July 2026 (99.61%). This entitles us to service credits of Rs 20,000 (5% × Rs 2,00,000 × 2 months), which have not yet been claimed or applied. We request these be credited against the pending September 2026 invoice (INV-2609-07) or the first renewal invoice.

Given current market rates for comparable services, we propose a renewal increase capped at 7%, per Clause 8.2, alongside the SLA credit adjustment above. We are happy to discuss further and finalize terms promptly.

Please confirm your agreement to these terms at your earliest convenience.

Best regards,
Nimbus Retail Procurement
